# DS Bot English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v0.3_preview-blue) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.2--rc.1-4D6BFE) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache_2.0-green) **[Download DS Bot for Windows 10/11 (64-bit) / 下载 Windows 10/11（64 位）版](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/latest)**, about 212 MB / 约 212 MB. A community project, not an official DeepSeek product. / 社区开源项目，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。 On that page, download `DS-Bot--win-x64.exe`. Double-click it to install; DS Bot opens when it is done. No administrator rights, no Node or DSH needed. You need a DeepSeek account (you can sign up with a phone number on the spot) or a DeepSeek API key. DeepSeek bills by usage: see [its prices](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing). For macOS, Linux or the DSH plugin, see [Install](README.md#install). 在这个页面下载 `DS-Bot-<版本>-win-x64.exe`，双击就会安装，装好自动打开。不用管理员权限，不用另装 Node 或 DSH。需要一个 DeepSeek 账号（可以当场用手机号注册）或 DeepSeek API Key。DeepSeek 按用量收费，见[价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing)。macOS、Linux 和 DSH 插件见[安装](README.zh.md#安装)。
The browser or Windows warns you, or blocks the installer? / 浏览器或 Windows 提示、拦下了安装包？ The installer is not signed yet, so Windows does not know its publisher. - Edge says the file is not commonly downloaded: **···** → **Keep** → **Show more** → **Keep anyway**. - "Windows protected your PC": **More info** → **Run anyway**. - "Smart App Control blocked …", with no **Run anyway**: there is no safe way around this for an unsigned installer. Use [DSH Desktop with the DS Bot plugin](README.md#install) instead. Do not turn Smart App Control off. - An antivirus blocks it: check the file first. In Command Prompt, run `certutil -hashfile SHA256` and compare the result with the file's line in `SHA256SUMS.txt` on the release page. If they match, choose to trust the file in the antivirus. - The installer says it could not uninstall the old version: close DS Bot and run the installer again. If your antivirus stopped the installer, check and trust it as above first. Still stuck? [Report an install problem](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/new?template=install.yml). 安装包还没有签名，所以 Windows 认不出发布者。 - Edge 提示「不常下载」：「···」→「保留」→「显示更多」→「仍然保留」。 - 「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。 - 「智能应用控制已阻止…」，而且没有「仍要运行」：未签名的安装包没有安全的绕过办法，请改用 [DSH Desktop 加 DS Bot 插件](README.zh.md#安装)。不要关掉智能应用控制。 - 杀毒软件拦截：先核对文件。在命令提示符里运行 `certutil -hashfile <文件> SHA256`，和 Release 页上 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 里这个文件的那一行比较，一致后再在杀毒软件里选「信任」。 - 安装时提示卸载旧版失败：先关掉 DS Bot，再运行一次安装包。杀毒软件拦了安装包时，先按上面的方法核对，选「信任」。 还是装不上？[报告安装问题](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/new?template=install.yml)。

detail.readme: # DS Bot English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v0.3_preview-blue) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.2--rc.1-4D6BFE) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache_2.0-green) DS Bot is an open-source project built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), available as a standalone desktop app or as a DSH plugin. It turns DSH into bots that you create, talk to and work with. ![Say one sentence to Chief, and it sets up the bots and the group chat](docs/images/team.png) ## Install **Desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux)** The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you don't need to install DSH first. Download the installer for your system from [Releases](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/latest), open it, and set up a model in Settings (it can also copy your existing bot team from DSH). If your system warns about an unsigned app: on Windows select **More info** → **Run anyway**; on macOS open **System Settings** → **Privacy & Security** and select **Open Anyway**. **As a plugin in DSH** First install DSH and set up at least one model in it. DS Bot uses the models from DSH. - **DSH Desktop**: In the sidebar, select **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, enter `ds-bot` (in mainland China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**), then select **Install** and **Enable now**. - **DSH Web** (needs Node.js `22.19` or later, and pnpm): ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add ds-bot npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 web ``` **Docker (NAS, Linux server)** See [`docker/README.md`](docker/README.md). ## Setup I strongly recommend that you set up your other bots and group chats by just talking to a bot. ### Web search DS Bot selects its `auto` search provider for the whole profile. If you disable `web-search-auto`, also select another registered search provider in that profile. See [Web search](ds-bot/README.md#web-search) and the [recovery steps](docs/known-issues.md#web-search-fails-everywhere-after-turning-off-web-search-auto). ## Features ### Bot You can do all your talking and work with one bot, in one window. You don't need to worry about the context behind it. The bot's details page shows its info, and there you can pick the model and thinking level you want it to use. You can switch models at any time, but I still recommend that you keep one model for a bot for a long time, and switch only when you really need to. Bots also have memory. A bot remembers what you like and uses it in later work. You can manage its memory on the bot's details page, or just tell the bot. Each bot can have its own working folder and permission preset — just tell the bot when you want to switch folders. While a bot is working, you can send a message to steer it right away, or type `/side` to ask a side question without interrupting its task; it can also draw charts, tables and forms in its replies, or run scheduled tasks. In the sidebar, you can group bots and group chats into collapsible sections by work. ![Bot details: model, memory, usage](docs/images/details.png) ### Main bot The main bot is your chief. It has very high rights: it manages the other bots and the group chats. The first time you open DS Bot, there is already a main bot called Chief. Talk to it, and it walks you through the setup. In short: have a question? Ask the main bot. ### Group chats DS Bot has group chats. A group chat is a great way to get several bots to work together, but it clearly costs more. So DS Bot does this: every group chat has an admin. The admin answers your messages by default and calls in the other bots for you. You can also @ a bot directly, and it answers you directly. To give the bots another chat as context, use + → Reference a chat in the message box. Any bot can hand work to other bots with @, and those bots do the work on their own and post the results back to the group. A group chat has its own memory and working folder, invisible to bots outside the group. For larger work, a group chat can run a Goal: the admin aligns with you on what "done" means, splits the work into stages across members, and checks each stage before moving on. ![Group chat: the admin, Chief, hands the work to Writer and Coder](docs/images/group.png) ### Private bot If you have private work that you only want to discuss with one bot, turn on Private in its settings and give it a separate working folder. Other bots cannot read its folder, memory or chat history, and sending messages to other bots or writing files outside its folder requires your approval. Even if you delete it, its folder and records stay protected until you release them in Settings. Note that a private bot cannot be a main bot or join group chats. This boundary only isolates it from other bots in your team, not as an OS sandbox: if you give it shell or network access, its commands can still read and write system files or reach the network, and its model provider still receives the conversation. ### Local agents Coding-agent CLIs you already use on your computer (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor CLI, Devin CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and others) can be connected as bots directly. Pick Local agent when creating a bot (or switch in the bot's settings), and it will use the CLI's own sign-in, plan and models while working like any other bot in private chats, group chats, handoffs and memory. There are a few limits to keep in mind: a local agent uses the CLI's own tools and context, so shared capabilities and connectors in DS Bot are not passed to it, and switching how a bot runs starts a fresh conversation part; custom CLIs without HTTP MCP support do not get team tools such as creating bots or handing off work. Also, Cursor CLI saves the last selected model as its own global default (`~/.cursor`), so if you pick a specific model for a Cursor bot in DS Bot, other Cursor bots on the default model and Cursor in your terminal will switch to it too — keep "CLI default" if you don't want to change your global default (sign in to Cursor first so the model list loads). ### Browser Each bot has its own isolated browser with separate sign-ins, and can import cookies from a file or from your local browsers. Turn on a browser plugin in Settings → Browser to let bots open and operate web pages on their own; posting, uploading, downloading and deleting need your approval, and sign-in, captchas or payments hand back to you with a card so you can take over and hand back at any time. The browser feature is available in the desktop app and DSH Desktop only (not in DSH Web), and only the desktop app keeps browser sign-ins after you quit and supports cookie import. On Windows, new Chrome and Edge cookies encrypted with v20 cannot be read directly — export them to a file with a browser extension first. ### Computer use Turn on Settings → Computer use to let bots operate apps on your computer as far as you allow. You can set a level (view only, background, or foreground) and allowed apps for each bot, with a top bar showing when a bot is working so you can pause or take over at any time; apps like system settings and password managers are never given to a bot. All bots share your desktop, so only one bot can use a given app or the foreground mouse at a time. On Windows, Chrome and Electron apps often ignore background input and need "foreground", and apps running as administrator cannot be controlled; macOS requires 14 or later with Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions; Linux supports X11, with limited Wayland support. ### IM In Settings → IM, you can link a bot or group chat to WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Discord or Slack. Once paired, you can talk to your bots, @ them in groups, and answer question and approval cards directly from your chat app without a public IP or open port on your computer. Messages only flow while your computer is awake and DS Bot is running. WeChat only supports private chat with the QR-paired account, not group chats; WeChat and QQ only allow replies within a platform time window after you send a message, and sending another message resumes it. WeChat, QQ and DingTalk do not have card buttons, so reply with the option number instead; for security, secret cards cannot be filled in from chat apps. ### Connectors and capabilities In Settings → Connectors, you can sign in to GitHub, Gmail, QQ Mail, 163 and other mailboxes, and remote MCP servers, or import existing configs from Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code. Credentials stay in DS Bot's secrets so bots never see the raw values, and emails written by a bot wait for your confirmation by default. In Settings → Capabilities, you can manage shared MCP servers, skills and packs for the team and enable them per bot; local commands added by a bot need your approval before they run. ### Office files Bots can create, check and edit Word (`.docx`), PowerPoint (`.pptx`) and Excel (`.xlsx`) documents directly, and render pages to images to check layout. The desktop app includes the full runtime out of the box; DSH Web does not bundle this runtime, so it can only check and edit existing documents, while creating files from scratch and rendering pages require the desktop app or DSH Desktop. ### Usage In **Settings** → **Usage**, you can see token usage by time, by bot and by model. ![Usage page](docs/images/usage.png) ## Data All data stays on your own computer: in the folder you chose on first start in the desktop app (`~/.ds-bot` by default), or in `bot/` and `sessions/` in the DSH home folder (`~/.dsh` by default) for the plugin. Uninstalling the app or the plugin does not delete this data. ## Development The plugin source is in [`ds-bot/`](ds-bot/). For options and internals, see [`ds-bot/README.md`](ds-bot/README.md). For development, tests and how the team works, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For changes between versions, see [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Acknowledgments - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): DS Bot is built on the DSH plugin system. Every bot works in DSH sessions and uses the DSH tools and models. - [esbuild](https://esbuild.github.io/): bundles the plugin's interface code. - Thanks to these projects for the ideas they published. DS Bot learned from their designs and does not contain their code: - [AgentMemoryRepo](https://github.com/AgentMemoryRepo/agentmemoryrepo): the Markdown format of Bot memory. - [OpenAI Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex): checkpoints that keep the user's messages next to the summary, and message anchors for chat search. - [OpenMausBot](https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot): group chat rounds and @mention relays. - [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) and [Hermes Bot Mode](https://github.com/NousResearch/Hermes-Bot-Mode): one session per member per group chat, and handoffs that carry the earlier user messages. - [OpenCode](https://github.com/sst/opencode), [goose](https://github.com/block/goose), [pi](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono) and [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli): when to condense a long chat, and what a handoff note holds. - [obelisk](https://github.com/tommy0103/obelisk): chat search with a SQLite full-text index. - Everyone who tries DS Bot, asks questions and reports bugs. ## License [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). Provided "as is", without any warranty. Third-party code and its license are listed in [NOTICE](NOTICE). ## Disclaimer DS Bot is an independent community project. **It is not an official DeepSeek product**, and it is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by DeepSeek. "DeepSeek", "DeepSeek Harness" and the other names are trademarks of their owners. They are used here only to say what this plugin works with. Bots use your own model quota, and they read and write files and run commands when you ask them to. Check important actions yourself.
detail.readme_zh: # DS Bot [English](README.md) | 中文 ![版本](https://img.shields.io/badge/版本-v0.3_预览-blue) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.2--rc.1-4D6BFE) ![许可](https://img.shields.io/badge/许可-Apache_2.0-green) DS Bot 是一个基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（简称 dsh）的开源项目，提供独立桌面应用和 dsh 插件两种形态。它将 dsh 改造为 bot 形式，你可以与自己创建的 bot 交流、工作。 ![和 Chief 说一句话，它就把 bot 和群聊建好](docs/images/team.zh.png) ## 安装 **桌面应用（Windows、macOS、Linux）** 桌面应用自带 dsh，不用先装 dsh。直接在 [Releases](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/latest) 下载对应系统的安装包，打开后在设置里配好模型就能用（也可以直接复制你原来在 dsh 里的 bot 团队）。 如果安装或打开时提示未签名拦截：Windows 点 **更多信息** → **仍要运行**；macOS 在 **系统设置** → **隐私与安全性** 里点 **仍要打开**。 **作为 dsh 插件** 先装好 dsh，并在 dsh 里配好至少一个模型。ds bot 直接使用 dsh 里的模型。 - **dsh Desktop**：侧栏点 **插件** → **添加插件**，包名填 `ds-bot`（在中国大陆，安装源选 **中国大陆镜像源**），点 **安装** 并 **立即启用**。 - **dsh Web**（需要 Node.js `22.19` 以上和 pnpm）： ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add ds-bot npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 web ``` **Docker（NAS、Linux 服务器）** 见 [`docker/README.md`](docker/README.md)。 ## 配置 我强烈建议你直接通过和 bot 对话来配置其他 bot 和群聊。 ### 网页搜索 DS Bot 会把 `auto` 搜索 provider 选为整个 profile 的后端。禁用 `web-search-auto` 时，也要为该 profile 选择另一个已注册的搜索 provider。详见[网页搜索说明](ds-bot/README.md#web-search)和[恢复步骤](docs/known-issues.zh.md#关掉-web-search-auto-后所有会话的网页搜索都失败)。 ## 功能 ### Bot 你可以在一个窗口中和一个 bot 完成所有对话和工作，你无需担心背后的上下文问题。你可以在 bot 详情页查看 bot 信息，也可以为 bot 选择你想使用的模型和思考强度。你可以随时切换模型，但我仍然建议你为一个 bot 长期保持一个模型，仅在真正必要的时刻切换。 另外，bot 拥有记忆，它会记住你的喜好并在下次的工作中应用。你可以在 bot 的详情页管理记忆，也可以直接和 bot 对话来进行管理。 每个 bot 可以单独设置工作文件夹和权限，换文件夹直接和它说一声就行。它干活时你可以随时插话，或者输入 `/side` 开侧边对话顺手问一句而不打断它；它也能在回复里直接画图表、表格和表单，或者跑定时任务。侧边栏里还可以把 bot 和群聊按工作收进分组。 ![bot 详情页：模型、记忆、用量](docs/images/details.zh.png) ### Main bot 这个 bot 作为你的 chief，它拥有非常高的权限，可以管理其他 bot 和群聊。第一次进入 ds bot 时，默认会有一个 main bot 叫 Chief。你可以直接和它对话，让它引导你完成配置。 总之，有问题，找 main bot。 ### 群聊 ds bot 拥有群聊功能。群聊是非常好的多 bot 协作方式，但它会带来非常明显的费用问题。ds bot 为此特意做了优化：在一个群聊中，你需要设置一个管理员。你的消息默认由管理员回复，它会帮你调用其他 bot。你也可以直接 @ 你需要沟通的 bot，它会直接回应你。想让 bot 参考另一段对话，点输入框的 + → 引用对话就行。 任何 bot 都可以用 @ 把活派给其他 bot，接活的 bot 自己去做，做完把结果发回群里。群聊有自己独立的记忆和工作文件夹，群外的 bot 看不到。做大任务时，群聊可以设定目标（Goal），由管理员先和你对齐完成标准，再拆成阶段分给成员，逐段验收推进。 ![群聊：管理员 Chief 把活派给写手和程序员](docs/images/group.zh.png) ### 隐私 bot 如果有些私密工作你只想和一个 bot 聊，可以在它的设置里打开隐私，并给它设一个独立的工作文件夹。其他 bot 读不到它的文件夹、记忆和聊天记录，它向其他 bot 发消息或写外部文件也必须先经你批准。就算删掉它，原来的内容也会继续受保护，直到你在设置里手动解除。 要注意，隐私 bot 不能作为 main bot，也不能进群聊。这道隔离只防团队里的其他 bot，不是系统沙箱：如果给了它终端命令或联网权限，它仍然能读写系统文件或联网，模型服务商也会收到对话内容。 ### 本地 Agent 你电脑上已经在用的编程 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor CLI、Devin CLI、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 等）可以直接接入当 bot 用。新建 bot 时选本地 Agent（或在 bot 设置里切换），它就会直接用 CLI 自己的登录、套餐和模型，同时照常参与私聊、群聊、派活和记忆。 不过有几点限制：本地 Agent 走的是 CLI 自己的工具和上下文，ds bot 里的共享能力和连接器不会传给它，切换运行方式也会新开一段对话；不支持 HTTP MCP 的自定义 CLI 拿不到建 bot、派活等团队工具。另外，Cursor CLI 会把最后一次切换的模型存成它自己的全局默认（`~/.cursor`），如果你在 ds bot 里给某个 Cursor bot 选了具体模型，其他用默认模型的 Cursor bot 和你终端里的 Cursor 都会跟着变，不想改全局默认的话保持“CLI 默认”即可（需要先登录 Cursor 才能看到模型列表）。 ### 浏览器 每个 bot 有自己独立的浏览器，登录状态互不干扰，也支持从文件或本机浏览器导入 Cookie。在 设置 → 浏览器 里开启操作插件后，bot 可以自己打开和操作网页；发帖、上传、下载、删除需要你批准，遇到登录、验证码或付款会发卡片交给你处理，你随时可以接管再交还。 浏览器功能仅桌面应用和 dsh Desktop 可用（dsh Web 没有），且只有桌面应用在退出后会保留网页登录状态、支持导入 Cookie。Windows 上 Chrome 和 Edge 开启了 v20 加密的新 Cookie 无法直接读取，需要先用浏览器扩展导出成文件再导入。 ### 电脑操控 在 设置 → 电脑操控 里打开开关后，bot 可以在你允许的范围内操作电脑上的应用。你可以给每个 bot 单独设档位（只看、后台操作、可以动前台）和允许使用的应用，操作时屏幕顶部有指示条，随时能暂停或接管；系统设置、密码管理这类应用永远不会交给 bot。 所有 bot 和你共用同一个桌面，同一个应用或前台鼠标同一时间只能有一个 bot 用。Windows 上 Chrome、Electron 这类应用在后台常收不到点击和输入，需要设为“可以动前台”，且无法操作管理员权限的应用；macOS 需要 14 及以上并开启辅助功能与屏幕录制权限；Linux 支持 X11，Wayland 受限。 ### IM 在 设置 → IM 里，可以把 bot 或群聊连到微信、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord 或 Slack。配对账号后就能在聊天软件里直接对话、在群里 @ 机器人、回复提问卡和审批卡，电脑不需要公网地址或开放端口。 只有你的电脑开着、ds bot 在运行时才能收发消息。微信只支持和扫码账号私聊，不支持群聊；微信和 QQ 受平台限制，只有在你发消息后的一段时间内能回复，超时后你在聊天软件里再发一句就能恢复。微信、QQ、钉钉没有卡片按钮，直接回复数字编号来选择；出于安全，密钥卡不能在聊天软件里填。 ### 连接器与能力 在 设置 → 连接器 里，可以登录 GitHub、Gmail、QQ 邮箱、163 等邮箱和远程 MCP 服务，也能从 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code 导入已有配置。凭据保存在 ds bot 的密钥里，bot 看不到明文，写的邮件默认也要你确认后才发。 在 设置 → 能力 里，可以管理团队共享的 MCP 服务、技能和能力包，并在每个 bot 的设置里按需开启；bot 自己添加的本地命令需要先经你批准才能运行。 ### Office 文件 bot 可以直接创建、检查和修改 Word（`.docx`）、PowerPoint（`.pptx`）和 Excel（`.xlsx`）文档，还能把页面渲染成图片来检查排版。桌面应用已经自带完整的运行环境，开箱即用；dsh Web 没有打包这套环境，只能检查和修改已有文档，从零建文件和渲染页面需要用桌面应用或 dsh Desktop。 ### 用量 在 设置 → 用量 里，可以按时间、按 bot、按模型查看 Token 用量。 ![用量页](docs/images/usage.zh.png) ## 数据 所有数据都在你自己的电脑上：桌面应用存在首次启动选定的位置（默认 `~/.ds-bot`），插件版存在 dsh 主目录（默认 `~/.dsh`）的 `bot/` 和 `sessions/` 里。卸载应用或插件不会删除这些数据。 ## 开发 插件源码在 [`ds-bot/`](ds-bot/)。配置项和内部结构见
